entities.summary: Rafael Midkhatovich Akhmetov is a Russian ice hockey coach and former professional ice hockey player, who currently serves as an assistant coach for Irbis Kazan of the Junior Hockey League (MHL). He most recently played with Lada Togliatti of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
